description: Standardized end-to-end ML pipeline in one YAML — source + steps + outputs. 28 ops covering feature engineering, hyperparameter tuning (grid / random / **bayesian** via Optuna), evaluation, interpretability, and model persistence. Any sklearn / XGBoost / LightGBM estimator via `sklearn_class:` escape hatch. Opt-in `experiment_tracking:` block auto-logs params / metrics / model artifacts to MLflow and/or Weights & Biases from every train / evaluate / *_search / cross_validate step. Rich per-step metadata (elapsed_seconds, model_class, hyperparams, CV mean/std, evaluate metrics, top feature) surfaces as `MetadataValue` on emitted assets — promote to Dagster+ Insights for training-cost / accuracy dashboards. Warehouse-connected via any Dagster resource. Partition-aware.

inputs.description: Source data — URL, file, warehouse SQL, or upstream asset (kind = url|file|warehouse_query|upstream_asset).

outputs.description: One or more first-class asset outputs (declared via outputs.assets: [step_ids]), plus optional csv / parquet / table sinks.

asset_name_prefix.label: Asset Name Prefix
asset_name_prefix.description: Prefix for emitted asset names. Each step listed in outputs.assets becomes '{prefix}_{step_id}'.

source.label: Source
source.description: Data source. kind = url | file | warehouse_query | upstream_asset. warehouse_query requires resource_key + sql; auto-detects the required_resource_keys.

steps.label: Steps
steps.description: Ordered pipeline steps. Each: {id, op, ...op-specific args}. Steps chain by id — a step with `source:` (or `input:`, `model:`) points at another step's output; omit `source:` and it defaults to the most recent DataFrame in state. 28 ops: preprocessing (impute / scale / one_hot_encode / label_encode / tile_binning / outlier_clip / missing_indicator / quantile_transformer / power_transformer), selection + generation (filter / select / date_features / polynomial_features / pca), text features (tfidf / hashing_vectorizer), feature selection (variance_threshold / correlation_filter / mutual_info_selection), time-series (lag_features / rolling_window), split + CV (split / cross_validate), train (`train` / `grid_search` / `random_search` / **`bayesian_search`** — Optuna TPE sampler with `param_space:` and `n_trials`), evaluate / interpret (predict / predict_proba / evaluate / confusion_matrix / importance / shap_values), persist (save_model).

outputs.label: Outputs
outputs.description: Output declaration. Shape: {assets: [<step_ids>], csv_sinks: [], parquet_sinks: [], table_sinks: []}. `assets:` step outputs become first-class Dagster assets; sinks are side effects. All sink paths are `{partition_key}`-aware; table_sinks accept a `partition_column:` for the analytics-friendly single-table pattern, plus `mode: upsert_on_match, match: [col, col]` for idempotent partition-rewrite (DELETE-then-INSERT keyed by match tuple, in a transaction — safe to re-run the same partition).

experiment_tracking.label: Experiment Tracking
experiment_tracking.description: Opt-in tracker config for train / evaluate / cross_validate / grid_search / random_search / bayesian_search steps. Two backends (either OR both — silently no-op when the library isn't installed): `mlflow: {tracking_uri_env_var, experiment_name, run_name_template, log_model, tags}` (auto-`log_params` + `log_metrics` from every tracker-aware op; `log_model: true` uses `mlflow.sklearn.log_model`), `wandb: {project_env_var, api_key_env_var, entity_env_var, run_name_template, tags}`. `run_name_template` supports `{prefix}` / `{partition_key}` / `{run_id}`. Metrics are prefixed with the step id (e.g. `tuned.n_estimators`, `metrics.accuracy`) so multiple steps can log to the same run without collisions.

group_name.label: Group Name
group_name.description: Group name for emitted assets. Default: 'ml'.

tags.label: Tags
tags.description: Additional tags for the emitted assets.
